name: Text Diff
description: Compare two texts: line-level diff for text, structured path diff for JSON.

hints.mode: Text mode diffs line by line with LCS; JSON mode annotates changes by structured path such as $.items[0].name.
hints.output: The result reports added, removed and unchanged counts; in JSON mode every change is listed by path.

faq.q: Why is an empty side an error?
faq.a: A diff needs both sides; an empty input cannot be compared and is reported as a missing field.

faq.q: How are array length changes handled in JSON mode?
faq.a: Items are compared by index: extra elements are marked as inserted and missing ones as deleted.
